narrative.overview: Orbit is sleek, professional, and easy for non-technical people. It provides a linear, precise, enterprise-grade experience. It explicitly avoids the generic purple-gradient SaaS tropes and consumer fintech warmth.
keyCharacteristics: Precise data display with tabular alignments.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: All numeric columns and data values must use tabular-nums so numbers align flawlessly in tables.

dos: Do use tabular-nums for all numeric values and percentages.
Do align tables and prioritize data density.
Do use skeleton screens for loading states.
donts: Don't use generic purple-gradient SaaS backgrounds.
Don't use consumer fintech warmth, rounded bubbly cards or pastel fills.
Don't animate data values; motion is for transitions only.
Don't use dark mode neon dashboards with glowing effects.
